turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm feeling okay, a bit tired but not in too much pain.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good to hear. Can you tell me your pain level on a scale from 0 to 10?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any nausea or feeling like you might vomit?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I feel fine, no sickness at all.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. How's your breathing? Any discomfort or tightness in your chest?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Breathing is fine, no problem there.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Did you experience any awareness or discomfort during the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I don't remember anything, slept through it all.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Given your diabetes and high blood pressure, are you having any dizziness or vision changes?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, everything looks and feels normal to me.
